specs.Supported Application: Camera, GPS, Phone Call, Fitness Tracker, Messages, Alarm, Pedometer, Weather, Reminders, Calendar, Music Player, Voice Assistant

features: HD Voice & Video Calls: The imoo Z1 Kids Smartwatch is a standalone 4G kids' smartwatch that supports voice and video calls through WiFi or cellular data. Equipped with a 2MP front camera, the imoo Z1 provides smooth, HD-quality voice and video calls. The watch also features an SOS function, instantly notifying parents and offering peace of mind

Precise Location Tracking: Powered by Google Maps and 5 satellite positioning systems, the imoo Z1 offers up to 10-meter accurate real-time location tracking. Parents can also monitor their child's movement through the imoo app

Built for Kids, Trusted by Families: Designed for children aged 3–14, the imoo Z1 is IPX8 water-resistant, shockproof, and dustproof, ensuring durability during active play. Its unique ScreenSafe design minimizes the risk of screen damage. Regular software updates and reliable customer support keep families satisfied

Most Powerful Parental Controls: Manage your child's safety effortlessly using the imoo app. Add trusted contacts, block unknown callers, view call logs, set reminders, enable Class Mode, and approve new app users all from your smartphone

Class Mode & Stranger Rejection: Parents can activate Class Mode to block distractions during school hours or study time. Stranger Rejection prevents unknown contacts from reaching your child, ensuring they stay focused and safe
High-Quality Construction: This smartwatch is made of high-quality materials that are toxic-free, ensuring safe usage for children during daily wear and various activities
